description: MainActivity.kt defines the primary activity for the Tic Tac Toe Android app, managing UI interactions, game mode switching, score display, and accessibility features.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Primary Android activity handling the UI and user interaction for the Tic Tac Toe game.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, and binds views.

methods.name: bindViews
methods.description: Associates UI elements with code variables and sets up listeners.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Configures game mode (PvP or PvC), resets the board, and updates UI.

methods.name: updateModeButtons
methods.description: Updates visual states of mode selection buttons.

methods.name: onCellTapped
methods.description: Handles user taps on game board cells.

methods.name: maybeTriggerComputerMoveIfNeeded
methods.description: Initiates computer move in PvC mode if applicable.

methods.name: renderAll
methods.description: Redraws scores, board, status, and mode buttons.

methods.name: renderBoard
methods.description: Updates the visual representation of the game board and accessibility descriptions.
